name: RIVEN
old_description: RIVEN is a multidisciplinary studio that designs heirloom quality furniture and objects.  Each piece is carefully handcrafted in our Vermont workshop using time honored techniques and Eco-friendly finishes.  Our mission is to elevate the everyday through elegant, understated design.
about:
RIVEN operates a multidisciplinary studio and workshop in Burlington, Vermont, describing itself as a studio that designs heirloom-quality furniture and objects. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The studio produces furniture and objects using traditional handcraft techniques and eco-friendly finishes. Its services span bespoke furniture, interior design, product development, prototyping, and eco-finishing for both private and business clients. No details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

RIVEN serves private individuals and business clients seeking custom furniture and design services. Specific industries are not listed, but the work spans residential, commercial, and product development contexts.

The company states its mission is to elevate the everyday through elegant, understated design, emphasizing heirloom quality, time-honored techniques, and environmentally conscious finishes.
